request_english: Redesign the post-day UI_Store prefab in the linked Figma file. Save the planning prompt as JSON first, then assemble new image-backed UI components in Figma. Match the existing game art and UI tone, and support expandable card lists for both fillings and future gameplay items.

target.provided_node_note: The supplied node is the page named '하진 · Story Cutscene'. Store work must be placed on a new page named 'Store UI · PC' to avoid mixing unrelated story and UI assets.

current_store_limitations: UI_Store.cs only binds category labels, balances, the next-day action, and the HIVE shop action.
There is no reusable product-card component or data-driven filling/item list in the prefab.
The current product area is a single horizontal scroll row, which does not scale well as products increase.

existing_figma_style.background: Night Korean bungeoppang street-stall watercolor image
figma_fonts: Gowun Batang Bold for rare display headings
existing_figma_style.unity_font_note: Unity currently uses omyuPretty SDF; Figma uses Noto Sans KR for readable production UI.

figma_local_system.relevant_library_search_result: No matching game-store product card, tab, button, color, or spacing asset was found.

design_prompt.goal: Create a polished post-day store screen that feels like the same Korean winter street-stall game, makes balances and the next-day action easy to find, and scales from a few fillings to many future items.
tone: restrained brick red and deep teal accents
friendly rather than luxurious or mobile-commerce-like
avoid: Japanese visual motifs such as torii, sakura, seigaiha, noren, or Japanese calligraphy
visible interface artwork made from Figma rectangles, ellipses, polygons, or hand-built vectors
too many currencies or unexplained upgrade rules
tiny text and narrow click targets
design_prompt.asset_policy: Visible backgrounds, panel skins, tab skins, card skins, buttons, badges, and icons must be raster image assets or existing uploaded game images. Figma frames may be used only as layout containers, masks, and component roots; text remains editable.

screens.name: UI_Store · Fillings
screens.content: Four available filling cards plus locked/next-unlock examples using the eight existing FillingType entries.

screens.name: UI_Store · Items
screens.content: Expandable item-card examples for 동시 붓기 and 조리 피버, plus one future-item placeholder. Detailed balance, duration, and upgrade content is intentionally not specified.

screen_layout.background: Reuse the existing Figma night-stall watercolor image at full bleed with a navy dim layer baked into or paired with the image asset.

store_panel.description: Large image-backed hanji ledger panel, centered, with enough room for 4 product cards per row.

header.left: 상점 title and short next-day preparation copy
header.right: Two image-backed balance chips: 보유금 and 팥 코인

category_tabs.behavior: Selected and unselected image-backed tab variants; selection changes only the card content area.

content_area.visible_rows: 1 full row plus a partial next row as a scroll cue
content_area.reason: A vertical grid stays readable when fillings and gameplay items grow beyond the current four categories.

footer.right: Fixed primary image button labeled 다음 날 영업

component_plan.name: Store/ProductCard
component_plan.content_rule: The artwork slot, name, concise effect/description, currency slot, and action state must remain stable for future data-driven generation.

items.name: 동시 붓기
items.description: 붕어빵 두 칸에 반죽을 함께 붓는 기능을 위한 카드 예시

items.name: 조리 피버
items.description: 일정 시간 조리 흐름을 빠르게 만드는 기능을 위한 카드 예시

sample_content.content_scope_note: Exact prices, duration, upgrade levels, balance, and purchase rules are excluded from this design pass.

image_asset_prompts.prompt: Front-facing Korean winter street-stall game UI panel skin, warm cream hanji paper with subtle handmade watercolor fibers, restrained dark teal edge and tiny brick-red stitch accents, broad clean center for text and cards, no text, no icons, no objects, no Japanese motifs, transparent outside the panel, production-ready raster UI asset.

Front-facing collectible product card skin for a Korean bungeoppang street-stall game, light cream handmade paper, soft watercolor edge, subtle fish-scale embossing inspired by bungeoppang but not Japanese patterns, clear rectangular artwork window and clean lower information zone, no text, no icons, transparent outside, production-ready raster UI asset.

Raster UI kit for a Korean bungeoppang street-stall game: selected deep teal paper tab, unselected warm tan paper tab, primary brick-red long button, disabled muted gray-teal button, small cream status badges; all front-facing, handmade watercolor and hanji texture, blank with no text or icons, no Japanese motifs, generous padding, transparent background, consistent lighting and edges.

figma_assembly.component_usage: Build each screen from component instances. Do not detach instances for screen composition.
asset_sources: Reuse the existing Figma night-stall background image hash.
Upload the existing Unity fillings and coin artwork.
Upload generated panel/card/tab/button raster assets after approval.
figma_assembly.text_policy: Use Noto Sans KR Bold/Regular for legibility; reserve Gowun Batang Bold only for the main heading if it remains readable.
prototype_notes: 붕어빵 소 tab switches to UI_Store · Fillings.
아이템 tab switches to UI_Store · Items.
Card action states visually distinguish available, owned, locked, and disabled.
다음 날 영업 remains fixed and visually dominant.

out_of_scope: Final item economy and price balancing
validation: Confirm both 1920x1080 screens keep a 64px safe margin.
Confirm card text remains readable at game-view scale.
Confirm four cards fit without overlap and the next row provides a visible scroll cue.
Confirm both balances and the next-day button remain visible while content scrolls.
Confirm the design uses image-backed visible surfaces instead of Figma-drawn decorative shapes.
Confirm no Japanese visual motifs are introduced.
